description_en: Creates an origin IPAM pool for a site. After creation, the origin IPAM pool can be used for load balancing or for direct back-to-origin routing in records
description_zh: 在站点在创建源地址池，创建成功后，源地址池可以用于负载均衡器，也可以用于记录直接回源
name: CreateOriginPool

parameters.help_en: The name of the origin address pool. The name must be unique within a site
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池名称，一个站点下源地址池名称唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the origin address pool is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
源地址池是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用
parameters.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The addresses of the origin server, such as www.example.com. If Type is set to tunnel_route, enter the decimal character string of an existing tunnel routing ID
fields.help_zh: 源站地址，如：www.example.com。Type为tunnel_route时，填写已有隧道路由ID的十进制字符串
fields.name: address

fields.help_en: The access key required for private authentication
fields.help_zh: 私有鉴权时需要传的access key
fields.name: access_key

fields.help_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

public: public read/write. Used when the origin server is an OSS or S3 origin server with public read/write access.
private_same_account: private same-account. Used when the origin server is an OSS origin server and the authentication type is same-account private authentication.
private_cross_account: private cross-account. Used when the origin server is an OSS origin server and the authentication type is cross-account private authentication.
private: private. Used when the origin server is an S3 origin server and the authentication type is private
fields.help_zh:
鉴权类型。

public：公共读写，源站为OSS或S3且为公共读写时使用；
private_same_account：私有同账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为同账号私有鉴权时使用；
private_cross_account：私有跨账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为跨账号私有鉴权时使用；
private：源站为S3，且鉴权类型为私有时使用
fields.name: auth_type

fields.help_en: The region of the origin server required when the origin server is an AWS S3 origin server
fields.help_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的源站region
fields.name: region

fields.help_en: The secret key required for private authentication
fields.help_zh: 私有鉴权时需要传的secret key
fields.name: secret_key

fields.help_en: The signature version required when the origin server is an AWS S3 origin server
fields.help_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的签名版本
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: The authentication information. If the origin server is an OSS or S3 origin server that requires authentication, you must specify the authentication configuration
fields.help_zh: 鉴权信息，源站为OSS或者S3等源站需要鉴权时，需要传鉴权相关配置信息
fields.name: auth_conf

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the origin server is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
fields.help_zh:
源站是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The request header included in back-to-origin requests. Only Host is supported
fields.help_zh: 回源时带的请求头，只支持Host
fields.name: header

fields.help_en:
The IP protocol version used for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:

round_robin: the default policy. Randomly polls IPv4 or IPv6 origin servers.
ipv4_first: prioritizes IPv4 origin servers.
ipv6_first: prioritizes IPv6 origin servers.
follow: follows the IP version used by the client
fields.help_zh:
回源请求使用的 IP 协议版本：
round_robin：默认策略，随机轮询 IPv4 或 IPv6 源站
ipv4_first：优先使用 IPv4 源站
ipv6_first：优先使用 IPv6 源站
follow：优先跟随客户端使用的 IP 版本
fields.name: ip_version_policy

fields.help_en: The name of the origin server. The name must be unique within an origin address pool
fields.help_zh: 源站名称，一个源地址下源站名称唯一
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The type of the origin server. Valid values:

ip_domain: an IP address or domain name origin server.
OSS: an OSS origin server.
S3: an AWS S3 origin server.
tunnel_route: a tunnel route origin server. Set Address to an existing tunnel route ID. You do not need to specify InnerType and SourceInfo
fields.help_zh:
源站类型：

ip_domain: ip或域名类型源站；
OSS：OSS地址源站；
S3：AWS S3源站；
tunnel_route：隧道路由源站，Address填写已有隧道路由ID，无需传InnerType和SourceInfo
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The weight. Valid values: integers from 0 to 100
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The information about the origin servers added to the origin address pool. Pass multiple origin servers as an array
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息，多个源站使用数组传值
parameters.name: origins

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

Id.description_en: The ID of the newly created origin address pool
